major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it close to on cooldown for the healing, damage, and crit boost rather than saving it for later.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 31884 is the observed cast and self-aura id (5/5 parses). 384376 shares the name and was not observed; it is not used.

major_cooldowns.name: Aura Mastery
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take the time your raid leader assigns; otherwise fire it once people are actually injured rather than pre-emptively, and line it up with an active Beacon of Virtue window in raids.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it close to on cooldown, on an ally when you need healing and on an enemy when you want damage, at 2 or fewer Holy Power so it does not overcap you.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Prism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: If talented instead of Divine Toll, cast it on an enemy for the most healing, or on a specific ally if needed, at 2 or fewer Holy Power.
major_cooldowns.id_note: NOT observed in the sampled parses; the guide names it as the alternative talent to Divine Toll.

major_cooldowns.name: Lay on Hands
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it as a full emergency heal on yourself or an ally; it does not transfer through your Beacons, so it is direct spot healing only.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Bulwark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Lightsmith, press it close to on cooldown at 2 or fewer Holy Power; cast it on a squishy target, or on yourself to send the bonus copy from Solidarity to a tank.
major_cooldowns.id_note: NOT observed in the sampled parses (no Lightsmith build represented). 432459 is the castable armament id; 432800 shares the name and is the applied buff.

major_cooldowns.name: Sacred Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Lightsmith, cast it on yourself close to on cooldown at 2 or fewer Holy Power; the bonus copy goes to another healer, or a DPS player if none is available.
major_cooldowns.id_note: NOT observed in the sampled parses (no Lightsmith build represented).

major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Crusader
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: If talented, use it close to on cooldown; it lets you weave Hammer of Wrath and Crusader Strike into your normal priority for its duration.
major_cooldowns.id_note: NOT observed in the sampled parses; class talent cooldown per the guide.

rule.description: Spend Infusion of Light before another Holy Shock
rule.action: Cast Flash of Light on the proc before pressing Holy Shock again, since another Holy Shock can generate a new one and overwrite it.

rule.description: Do not generate Holy Power while capped
rule.action: Spend your Holy Power on a spender before pressing a generator again; casting a generator while capped wastes the Holy Power it grants.

rule.description: Divine Toll only at low Holy Power
rule.action: Save Divine Toll for when you are at low Holy Power so the Holy Power it grants does not overcap you.

rule.description: Spend Holy Power before it overcaps
rule.action: Cast Eternal Flame once you reach 5 Holy Power instead of holding it and risking a wasted generator cast.

rule.description: Aura Mastery timed with Beacon of Virtue
rule.action: In raids, hold Aura Mastery until Beacon of Virtue is active so the two cooldowns overlap; in Mythic+ it is fine to separate them.
